title: Finiteness of KL divergence against a full-support measure
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite discrete measurable space, and let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on $\Omega$. If $
u$ assigns positive mass to every point, meaning $
u(\{\omega\}) 
eq 0$ for all $\omega \in \Omega$, then the Kullback–Leibler divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mu \,\|\, 
u)$ is finite.
